designBrief: Nostalgic railway-themed neighbourhood kopitiam at Clementi Arcade, Singapore, serving Peranakan-influenced home-style food. Palette from the business's own real logo (black nameplate) and real photographed interior (warm wood, vintage brass decor). Big Shoulders Display for headings (echoes railway station nameplate lettering, matching the logo), Bitter for body (warm slab-serif kopitiam-menu-board feel). Single-page, warm and nostalgic, photography-led. Signature element: a solid black rounded-pill 'nameplate' tag, directly traceable to the real logo's own badge shape, used for the eyebrow and menu category labels.
